warnings: 'X1-X1' is a secondary cross-section cut taken through BX1's own drawn profile (the 'X1' leader marks on BX1's section point to it) — not an independent member; folded into BX1's spec as a note rather than a separate top-level element.

'ต่อเนื่องจาก B<n>' ('continuing from B<n>') on B2X/B3X/B4X — recorded verbatim; these X-marks are lap-splice/continuation segments of their base mark, both top and bottom bars simply continuing, per §6a/§7's lap-splice handling precedent.
'ล้วงเข้า B2 ระยะ1.00ม.' on B2X (1 extra Ø16 bar lap-splicing into B2, 1.00m) recorded as an additional_bars entry on B2X per §7.

'nØd มม. หยุดที่ L/8' on B4 and B5 is a SEPARATE second bottom layer of extra bars, not the bottom bars themselves — its leader arrows point to two intermediate dots partway up the section, while the bottom face carries its own '3Ø…มม.' leader with three dots drawn. An earlier pass read the curtailed pair as the bottom reinforcement and lost one bottom bar on each of B4 and B5; both are now bottom 3 + additional_bars 2. Worth checking first on any beam whose top count exceeds its bottom count, which is what flagged these.
